thread:
maria.releases: Heads-up — we're pausing the EU canary rollout. Incident alert: S3 5xx spike.

deploybot: Rollout paused by policy (reason=infra-s3-5xx, initiator=auto). Affected: canary-2026-03-... v1.2.4 -> v1.2.5

sam_oncall: Thanks. Can we pin v1.2.4 for EU until we validate storage? :eyes:

jordan_sre: Yes. Reverting routing for EU to v1.2.4. I'll start rollback checklists. 

tasha_pm: Can we also hold the global change window for tonight's batch? Need to avoid partial rollout.

maria.releases: Agree. Maria to propose reschedule: move window +6h, stagger zones. I'll update release notes and notify product.

deploybot: Pin applied: service=api, env=eu, pinned_version=v1.2.4, note="incident: S3 5xx" 

jordan_sre: Per my checks, KV cache priming may be impacted on rollback. I'll monitor cache-miss rates and memory churn.

sam_oncall: Temporary mitigation: route 10% of traffic to fallback region where S3 errors not present. Config: `route set --svc api --region eu --fallback=us-west --pct=10`

tasha_pm: We'll need a short blurb for customer comms. Maria can you draft one? Keep it factual and say we deferred tonight's update.

maria.releases: Draft posted in #customer-cogs: "We delayed the EU update due to a transient storage incident; no customer data affected; new window XX:XX UTC." Will circulate for signoff.

deploybot: Release event updated: change_window=2026-03-20T22:00Z -> 2026-03-21T04:00Z, reason="incident reschedule". Tickets notified.

sam_oncall: SRE will re-evaluate at +1h. If S3 error rate <0.5% and retries stable, we can requeue canary with tighter slowness guard.

jordan_sre: Also tagging ops playbook link: https://intranet/redwood/playbooks/s3-5xx

maria.releases: Final check: everyone OK with pinned version + reschedule? Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm.

sam_oncall: :thumbsup:

tasha_pm: :thumbsup:

jordan_sre: :thumbsup: monitoring now.

maria.releases: Closing thread — deploybot will unpin when cleared or on manual release. Thanks team.
